reason: 不死身の果実の対象限定破壊マナ置換、フォーチュンドンキッキーの異なるタイプの任意取得と残り順序、邪魂転生の任意数同時破壊と実破壊数2倍ドローを全能力対応。
validationNotes: Baseline 3e36676b; clean working tree and index; nameKey 9317; AGENTS, prior 447 checks and historical incomplete results inspected.

Official exact-name searches found Fruit 2 prints, Fortune 1, Jakon 5. All 8 full faces, stats, images (visually reviewed), mana value 1 and current restrictions were verified. Only 3 distinct names added. Newest Fruit and Jakon text specifies destruction, not any graveyard movement.

Fruit uses a physical target reference, an external turn effect and the existing mana destruction replacement. It expires at turn end, respects non-destructive grave movement and affects no other allied creature. Actual Aqua Soldier exposed a missing competing original hand destination; both original hand and Fruit mana destinations are now offered and tested in both seats (QA35115). Replacement payments cannot be replaced again.

Fortune reuses public deck reveal, protected physical cards, normal zone movement and bottom ordering. Choose one type per selected card, never repeat an assigned type. Official comprehensive rule 810.3 supports choosing one half of a twin. Tests cover two twins assigned different types, an actual Tamaseed Creature using either type, 3 distinct types, 3 creatures, declining all and exact reverse bottom order.

Jakon selects all targets before one simultaneous destruction. The existing g865DrawDestroyed counts actual direct destructions; its optional multiplier defaults to one and is two for Jakon. Evolution sources do not inflate the count; a directly destroyed psychic still counts after returning to extra. Fruit mana and Soldier hand replacements draw nothing.

QA45903 reproduced in both seats with actual Hatter Rupia, Gareck, Jakon and 3 mana: declare both shield triggers, summon Gareck first, resolve Jakon and draw 2 before the waiting Hatter destruction. QA45907 reproduced in both seats with actual Cyber I Choice and Jakon: declare both, summon I Choice, remove the water creature seal in its rule window, then destroy both creatures with Jakon and draw 4.

48 focused tests, 104 destruction/leave regressions, 206 look/shuffle/previous-batch/online regressions: 358 passed. A legal forty-card seeded game preserved all physical UIDs and JSON legal actions. Encrypted online snapshots preserve pending type selections and hide the opposing hand.

Intermediate failures retained in logs: incorrect creature IDs used as a spell/ACE fixture, native last-card automatic ordering, missing g815PutInGrave for a non-destructive move, and an unconsumed command unseal choice were corrected. Aqua Soldier competition required a runtime correction. Final focused and affected regressions all pass.

check, audit, target9500 and baseline invariants pass. nameKey 9320, no duplicates. Existing 9317 definitions, IDs, images, pins, catalogue and save formats remain unchanged. Historical pending tests, deferrals and publication records retained. No push, publication or Netlify update.
